# wowprogress

WowProgress rankings and profile CLI.

## Global options

Pass these before the subcommand: `wowprogress --pretty <command> ...`.

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--pretty` | boolean | false | Pretty-print JSON for human reading. Default output is compact JSON. |
| `--compact` | boolean | false | Truncate long string fields to reduce payload size. |
| `--fields` | str (repeatable) |  | Return only selected fields (dot paths). Repeat or pass comma-separated values. |
| `--fields-strict` | boolean | false | Fail when a requested --fields dot-path is missing from the payload. |
| `--profile` | str |  | Output profile preset: agent (default compact JSON), human (pretty JSON), debug (pretty JSON + diagnostics). |
| `--compact-max-chars` | int range | 280 | Maximum string length before --compact truncation adds an ellipsis. |

## wowprogress doctor

Report WowProgress transport mode, cache configuration, and per-surface capability state.

## wowprogress search

Probe WowProgress guild and character routes for a structured query.

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `query` | str | required | Structured query like 'us illidan Liquid' or 'character us illidan Imonthegcd'. |

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--limit` | int range | 5 | Maximum results to return. |

## wowprogress sample pve-guild-profiles

Enrich the top leaderboard rows with their WowProgress guild pages.

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--region` | str | required | Region slug such as world, us, or eu. |
| `--realm` | str |  | Optional realm slug to narrow the PvE leaderboard. |
| `--limit` | int range | 10 | Maximum top leaderboard guild profiles to fetch. |
| `--faction` | str (repeatable) |  | Retain only guild profiles matching the given faction. Repeatable. |
| `--difficulty` | str (repeatable) |  | Retain only guild profiles matching the given progression difficulty. Repeatable. |
| `--world-rank-min` | int range |  | Retain only guild profiles at or above this world rank. |
| `--world-rank-max` | int range |  | Retain only guild profiles at or below this world rank. |
| `--item-level-min` | float |  | Retain only guild profiles at or above this average item level. |
| `--item-level-max` | float |  | Retain only guild profiles at or below this average item level. |
| `--encounter` | str (repeatable) |  | Retain only guild profiles containing the given encounter name. Repeatable. |

## wowprogress threshold

Threshold-style estimates derived from sampled WowProgress leaderboard rows.

## wowprogress threshold pve-leaderboard

Estimate where a target metric value sits inside a sampled PvE leaderboard slice.

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--metric` | str | rank | Threshold metric: rank, bosses_killed. |
| `--value` | float | required | Target metric value to estimate against the sampled leaderboard. |
| `--region` | str | required | Region slug such as world, us, or eu. |
| `--realm` | str |  | Optional realm slug to narrow the PvE leaderboard. |
| `--limit` | int range | 50 | Maximum leaderboard rows to sample. |
| `--nearest` | int range | 10 | Maximum nearby rows to include in the threshold estimate. |
